WITH units AS (
  SELECT s.sentreg, s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) as baseline
  FROM units
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_avg
  FROM units
),
units_with_baseline AS (
  SELECT u.sentreg, u.instownpct, u.ordertypedist, mb.baseline, oa.overall_avg
  FROM units u
  JOIN mix_baselines mb ON u.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM units_with_baseline
  WHERE instownpct > overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(instownpct) as avg_ownership_kept,
  AVG(instownpct / baseline) as avg_ownership_ratio,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) as avg_excess_ownership
FROM kept_units;
